gen-dafont-bloody-gf-oxygen: Oxygen keeps its curves open and its lowercase close to the capitals' height, a contemporary sans-serif voice. Oxygen handles quiet clarity while Bloody, with its big round bowls, handles the shouting.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-parkinsans: Big round bowls, then a flat stripe of ink. Bloody commands the top with big round lowercase, and Parkinsans draws one constant stroke in wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-puritan: Approachable, rounded and open to the side, never closing up. Bloody shouts from the heading while Puritan, with oversized e and a counters, keeps a long block of text easy going.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-roboto: Bloody comes in loud and commanding, all big round lowercase bowls. Roboto, a sans-serif with generous mouths on its round letters and little gap between capital and lowercase height, reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-stack-sans-headline: Big round lowercase bowls give Bloody its commanding look, while Stack Sans Headline stays a monoline sans built on wide gaps. Loud swagger above, cable-like line below, nothing swelling.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-stack-sans-text: Bloody announces itself with big round lowercase bowls, a commanding heading sitting over the marker-like line of Stack Sans Text. Text below flows smoothly, its curve endings kept well apart.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-tiktok-sans: Modern and spacious, the body text rises close to full cap height with a wide opening on the c. TikTok Sans keeps lines going comfortably for page after page, with Bloody left to do the shouting.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-yaldevi: Loud, round and unmissable: Bloody sets big lowercase bowls against a plain sans waiting quietly just below the headline. Yaldevi has outsized lowercase and an e that opens right.
gen-dafont-brusher-fs-plein: Brusher writes in a romantic, dynamic calligraphic hand, strokes running stem to terminal without contrast. Plein gives it a clear channel into each round letter, though it is built for brief lines rather than long paragraphs.
gen-dafont-brusher-fs-spline-sans: Romantic and dynamic, with a calligraphic hand and wide-open e. Brusher flourishes up top while Spline Sans, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, keeps light reading pleasant.
